name: Multimodal-Robustness-Benchmark
description: A suite of multimodal robustness tests designed to evaluate how multimodal models handle distribution shifts, corruptions, and adversarial or semantically challenging inputs across image+text settings. It aggregates robustness scenarios to measure model stability and performance degradation under varied perturbations.
evaluation_method: accuracy (task-dependent; measures performance drop under robustness perturbations)
reputation: Published on Hugging Face by BAAI for stress-testing multimodal models; used by researchers interested in robustness but not yet a de facto community standard.
